review_kind: PStack final actual closeout publication privacy/integrity/honesty review

source_bindings.reviewed_worktree_changes: Five task documentation/status files and the new closeout qualification directory; no production/test/package/workflow mutation.

path_label_convention: Repository-relative document/archive paths and portable member labels for scripts/context within the reviewed ZIP. No personal absolute filesystem paths are included in this report.

archive_integrity.bounds_scope: Measured actual archive sizes; not a guarantee about arbitrary future publisher inputs.

privacy.scope: Bounded actual-byte privacy and credential-pattern verification, not universal secret detection. Personal raw metadata is not reproduced in this report.

actual_evidence_verification.merge_readback: Retained proof records merged/closed PR642, expected ordered parents/tree equality and GitHub-reported verified/valid signature status. Local Git independently matches parents and tree; this review does not claim a new remote fetch or independent cryptographic signature verification.
actual_evidence_verification.premerge: Retained capture is bound to exact 7f/base89e5, seven completed successful checks and zero review threads with no next page.
actual_evidence_verification.postmerge_run_source_status: Retained API metadata records exact merge head, push event, completed/success; six jobs completed successfully.
actual_evidence_verification.six_postmerge_raw_logs: Recomputed all raw log hashes and byte counts against summary. Every log contains exact expected-head guard, actual typecheck/build/vitest commands, successful required steps, complete 2411-case suite summary and 24+3 new durability case markers.
actual_evidence_verification.seven_final_head_raw_logs: Recomputed all seven raw log hashes, checked final head presence and required-step success against the retained final verification record.
actual_evidence_verification.final_self_original_artifact: Found retained original ZIP matching verification and advertised SHA256. CRC and all three JSON members validate; envelope head/tree/base and receipt digest match. Original opaque ZIP remains excluded from publication.
actual_evidence_verification.closeout_review_hashes: All three review hashes referenced by qualification-closeout.json match retained original review files.
actual_evidence_verification.failure_accounting: Local native1/six deadline failures/34 skips, development dependency debt and actual inner Self packaging FAIL 3/3/material incompleteness/selector UNAVAILABLE remain explicit. Hosted passes do not erase local failures or establish their cause.

helper_delta.assessment: Finalizer uses retained exact merge/premerge/final-head/postmerge/review evidence, preserves the local failure and release blockers, and writes only task closeout data/status documents. The publisher adds this script only to the explicit closeout list; prior privacy and integrity logic is unchanged. No concrete security defect found within the trusted task-helper scope.

coverage_limits: Read-only review with local hashing, parsing, archive and retained-log verification; no archive regeneration, source/Git mutation, network fetch, test/build/install, merge or release action by this reviewer.
Verdict is bound to the exact hashes above. This report is outside the reviewed 150-member ZIP and can be copied beside it unchanged; it is not claimed to be embedded in that ZIP.
Later settings snapshot, future remote closeout publication/readback and planned cleanup actions are outside this review. No future bytes or cleanup operation are approved by this report.

Previously reviewed source and helper reports retain their own source bindings; this review is a narrow actual closeout publication delta, not a full repository security scan or release certification.
